title: Deep Planner Design-Capacity Qualification Corpus
authority: Offline Deep Planner qualification input and candidate oracle only; never production planning policy.
claim_boundary: Frozen assistant-authored, production-shaped, target-blind Deep Planner contrast corpus. It is same-model and non-independent; it is not training, deployed-model, voice, robot, release, or independent semantic evidence.

coverage_rationale.primary_unit: one required Deep Planner capacity from canonical design and qualification method section 7.3
coverage_rationale.matrix: Each of ten required Deep capacities has one supported/boundary one-axis contrast in both en-US and zh-CN. The combined Fast+Deep suite covers all fifteen maintained daily-life situation families; Deep uses ten distinct families because its exceptional path is exercised by capacity, not by duplicating every common Fast situation.
hard_boundaries: one Deep primary model result with no same-tier repair
no Fast candidate or validator feedback in Deep input
exact GA Goal scope and scoped re-entry Evidence
exact Capability IDs, arguments, timing, resource chain, and ownership
no executable partial Work on unavailable or unsafe boundaries
passive Agent Skill context cannot override Goal, catalog, or safety authority
declared_gaps: No deployed qwen3.5:4b/Ollama or vLLM inference
No live service, voice, simulator, or physical robot evidence
No claim that 40 scenarios enumerate every possible household task
Training remains prohibited until independent review promotes individual cases
